children: AdVini entered exclusive negotiations to acquire the Bonne Nouvelle and Mythique brands, which generate combined annual revenue of approximately €14M. Consideration includes 112,216 AdVini treasury shares valued at €35.20 each, plus cash for inventories; completion is expected in February 2027.
Two brands generate approximately €14M annual revenue
Adds disclosed revenue scale, but the release provides no comparison or purchase-price valuation.
Share consideration implies a stated value of about €3.9M; inventory costs are additional and payable in cash.
The deal remains proposed and subject to definitive documentation, employee consultations and relevant corporate approvals.
Vinadeis held 7.92% of AdVini after April 30 deal
The release says InVivo will increase its equity stake, but gives no revised percentage.

This is a proposed follow-on acquisition after AdVini completed a separate wine-business acquisition from Cordier by InVivo on April 30, 2026. Definitive documentation and completion are expected in February 2027, subject to employee consultation procedures and relevant corporate decisions.
